## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Amsterdam, Netherlands. It starts at 78, Rokin.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> See, smell, listen and be afraid, very afraid. All your senses will be on red alert at the Amsterdam Dungeon as you take a spooktacular walkthrough adventure into the 500-year-old history of Amsterdam. Enjoy 7 shows, meet a cast of characters, and prepare for goosebumps. Screaming encouraged.

## Price and rating

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €22.50. It was rated 4.6 out of 5 from 190 ratings and 129 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.

## Where this page comes from

This page was built on 13 November 2026 from WeGoTrip's partner data, the product information WeGoTrip gives its affiliates. We have not taken this tour ourselves, so check the listing for anything that matters to you before you book.
